newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - G&K Services EPS up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - G&K Services EPS up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securites Inc said Wednesday it raised its earnings estimate for G&K Services Inc to $1.35 a share from $1.30 for fiscal 1997, and introduced a fiscal 1998 estimate of $1.55 a share.

-- This week G&K reported earnings for the fiscal fourth quarter of $0.31 a share, up from $0.24 a year ago and above EVEREN's estimate of $0.29. It earned $1.11 a share for all of fiscal 1996, up from $0.90 a year ago.
-- "Healthy new business generation, ongoing industry consolidation and employment growth provide a favorable outlook for the uniform rental industry," EVEREN said in a report.
-- The six-month price target on the stock was raised to $32 from $28, and the 18-month target was increased to $35 from $32. EVEREN has an outperform rating on the stock.
